builds.name: Resistance smash carry
builds.summary: Test resistance smash carry against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test resistance smash carry against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Colossal Smash includes a 0.6 source-MR term and Hero's Entrance includes 1.0 source MR; defensive MR can therefore contribute magic damage while W shields and mitigates. Dusk and Dawn supplies a separate magic Spellblade attack between spell hits that refund passive cooldown.
testPlan: Required state: Enemy magic damage and repeated ability hits on champions.
Compare Smash and R damage with matched AP but different MR.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Physical compositions waste the MR focus; Smash still requires melee access.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: MR source statFormula=2 is not automatically verified bonus MR; R needs an allied landing target.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Abyssal Mask, Kaenic Rookern, Frozen Heart, Spirit Visage, Dusk and Dawn, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Galio designates an allied champion's position as his landing spot, granting all allied champions in the area Shield of Durand's passive Shield for [5] seconds. Galio then flies to his landing zone.

When Galio lands, he Knocks Up for [0.75] seconds and deals [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.7) × AP + (1) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] magic damage.

Passive: Galio gains a [(0.075 / 0.09 / 0.105 / 0.12 / 0.135) × Stat(12)] Magic Shield after not taking damage for [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=12, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds.

Begin Charging: Galio reduces incoming magic damage by [(0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 + (0.0004) × AP + (0.0008) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2] + (0.0001) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (1)] and incoming physical damage by [((0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 + (0.0004) × AP + (0.0008) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2] + (0.0001) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (1)) × (0.5)] and Slows himself by [15]%.

Release: Galio Taunts enemy champions for between [0.5] to [1.5] seconds, deals between [20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 + (0.3) × AP] and [(20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 + (0.3) × AP) × (3)] magic damage, and refreshes the damage reduction for [2] seconds. Taunt duration, damage, and range increase with charge time.

Galio's Attacks have increased attack speed and deal [characterLevelInterpolation(15 → 115; raw flags preserved) + (1) × AD + (0.4) × AP + (0.6) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] magic damage to surrounding enemies. 

This effect's cooldown is reduced by [3] seconds when Galio hits an enemy champion or epic monster with an ability, once per cast.
